items.title: Why Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) Is Up 6.5% After New da Vinci SP Transvaginal Approval – And What's Next
items.summary: Earlier this month, Intuitive Surgical received CE mark approval for using its da Vinci SP single-port robotic system in transvaginal gynecologic procedures, adding to its existing approvals for a range of endoscopic and natural-orifice surgeries across Europe. This world's-first indication for the SP platform deepens Intuitive’s position in minimally invasive, scarless surgery by broadening its clinically supported use in complex anatomical spaces. items.title: How Far Could ISRG Stock Bounce From Here?
items.summary: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) stock could climb 23.9% to the April high it last fell back from, and you would risk about 5% to find out. That looks like a surgical-robot leader on sale, but the price history disagrees. Over the last two years, none of its visits to this price range turned into a 20% gain before a 5% drop.
